# pr-1534: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner

## Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1534
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1534
- **Title**: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1532` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 1
- **Additions**: +118
- **Deletions**: -21
- **Created**: 2026-10-11T06:31:08Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T07:38:48Z

## PR Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1534
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1534
- **Title**: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1532` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 1
- **Additions**: +118
- **Deletions**: -21
- **Created**: 2026-10-11T06:31:08Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T07:38:48Z

## PR Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.

# pr-1534: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner

## Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1534
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1534
- **Title**: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1532` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 1
- **Additions**: +118
- **Deletions**: -21
- **Created**: 2026-10-11T06:31:08Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T07:38:48Z

## PR Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

### Thread 1 — `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-11):
💡 **SUGGESTION: index-based spike addressing is silently fragile**

`contendedClock(spiked: {6, 7, 8})` encodes the *exact* internal call layout of `medianWrapMs` (1 untimed warm-up + 5 timed runs, small-then-doubled per attempt). That coupling is documented in the comment, but nothing enforces it: if `runs` (or the measure loop) ever changes, the spike indices shift and the test can silently stop exercising the intended scenario. The worst case is subtle — spikes landing on the *small* measurement would *depress* the ratio, so the test stays green while asserting nothing about preemption survival.

A cheap guard would make the fake expose its call count so the test can assert the expected total (30 timed calls for 3 attempts × 2 sizes × 5 runs), turning a silent weakening into a loud failure.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-11):
💡 **SUGGESTION: unused knob parameters add surface without consumers**

`attempts`, `maxLinearRatio`, and `minGrowthRatio` are new tunable parameters on this test-only helper, but every call site either uses the defaults or passes only `elapsedUs`. Until a caller needs to vary them, consider inlining the constants (3, 3.2, 1.5) — they are already named and explained in the doc comment — so a future reader doesn't have to audit whether any call site overrides the guard bounds.

# pr-1534: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner

## Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1534
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1534
- **Title**: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1532` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 1
- **Additions**: +118
- **Deletions**: -21
- **Created**: 2026-10-11T06:31:08Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T07:38:48Z

## PR Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

`contendedClock(spiked: {6, 7, 8})` encodes the *exact* internal call layout of `medianWrapMs` (1 untimed warm-up + 5 timed runs, small-then-doubled per attempt). # pr-1534: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner

## Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1534
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1534
- **Title**: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1532` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 1
- **Additions**: +118
- **Deletions**: -21
- **Created**: 2026-10-11T06:31:08Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T07:38:48Z

## PR Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# pr-1534: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner

## Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1534
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1534
- **Title**: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1532` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 1
- **Additions**: +118
- **Deletions**: -21
- **Created**: 2026-10-11T06:31:08Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T07:38:48Z

## PR Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1534._

> ℹ️ **2 machine notice(s) excluded (arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets).**

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-11):
💡 **SUGGESTION: index-based spike addressing is silently fragile**

`contendedClock(spiked: {6, 7, 8})` encodes the *exact* internal call layout of `medianWrapMs` (1 untimed warm-up + 5 timed runs, small-then-doubled per attempt). That coupling is documented in the comment, but nothing enforces it: if `runs` (or the measure loop) ever changes, the spike indices shift and the test can silently stop exercising the intended scenario. The worst case is subtle — spikes landing on the *small* measurement would *depress* the ratio, so the test stays green while asserting nothing about preemption survival.

A cheap guard would make the fake expose its call count so the test can assert the expected total (30 timed calls for 3 attempts × 2 sizes × 5 runs), turning a silent weakening into a loud failure.

---

### Thread 2 — `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-11):

# pr-1534: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner

## Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1534
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1534
- **Title**: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1532` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 1
- **Additions**: +118
- **Deletions**: -21
- **Created**: 2026-10-11T06:31:08Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T07:38:48Z

## PR Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# pr-1534: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner

## Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1534
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1534
- **Title**: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1532` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 1
- **Additions**: +118
- **Deletions**: -21
- **Created**: 2026-10-11T06:31:08Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T07:38:48Z

## PR Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# pr-1534: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner

## Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1534
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1534
- **Title**: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1532` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 1
- **Additions**: +118
- **Deletions**: -21
- **Created**: 2026-10-11T06:31:08Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-11T07:38:48Z

## PR Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# pr-1534: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner

## Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

## PR Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).

# pr-1534: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner

## Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# pr-1534: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner

## Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

# pr-1534: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner

## Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.

Now let me check CI failures. There's no ci_failures_full.log in the input folder. ci_failures.md lists 4 failed checks: Binaries smoke gate, JS engine integration (quickjs-ng), Quality gate (x2). Let me check whether these checks exist in the repo and whether the failure relates to the change. Without full logs, I can't see the errors. Let me check if ci_failures_full.log exists elsewhere.

# pr-1534: gh-1532 FLAKE: wrap_ansi_line_perf_test timing assertion (2x input = 3.2x time) red on loaded runner

## Description

Closes #1532
### Root Cause

- `expectLinearGrowth` in `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` took a **single** doubling-ratio sample: ~3.8ms baseline (100k ASCII cells) vs ~7.2ms doubled, gated at 3.2x while linear measures ~2.0x. On a runner contended by release windows, one scheduler steal/GC pause of a few ms inside either `Stopwatch` window inflates that lone sample past 3.2x — the gh-1532 live failure (fa run 38113730068).
- Sub-5ms single-shot timing assertions are inherently unstable on shared runners; median-of-5 per size was not enough because a sustained steal contaminates ≥3 of 5 runs.

### Fix

- `test/cli/wrap_ansi_line_perf_test.dart` — `expectLinearGrowth` now takes **3 independent doubling attempts** and gates the superlinear guard on the **min** ratio: contention can only add wall time, so the min approaches the uncontended ratio. A genuine regression (~4x+ quadratic shape) still fails under min, in every attempt.
- Added a **meaningful-growth lower bound** (max ratio across attempts must exceed 1.5x; linear ≈ 2x) so the retry-min cannot become a rubber stamp — a degenerate flat measurement now fails (AC2).
- Threaded an injectable `ElapsedUs` clock through `medianWrapMs`/`expectLinearGrowth` (default: real `Stopwatch`, unchanged behavior) so contention is reproduced **deterministically** via `contendedClock` instead of by CI luck.
- No production changes (`wrapAnsiLine` untouched) — the flake was in the test harness only.

### Test Coverage

- RED first: both new tests failed pre-fix (the hermetic seam did not exist; the flat-clock scenario passed the old assertion while asserting nothing).
- `growth assertion survives a contended-runner preemption spike (gh-1532)` — 30ms fake preemption across 3 timed runs of one measurement (~9x ratio for that attempt) is discarded; PASSED.
- `growth assertion rejects a degenerate flat measurement (gh-1532)` — constant clock (ratio 1.0) must throw `TestFailure`; PASSED.
- Guard not weakened: spiking the doubled measurement in **all 3 attempts** still fails with a 7.09x min ratio.
- Perf file: 8/8 PASSED. `dart analyze` clean, `dart format` applied.
- Full unit suite (CI invocation `dart test --exclude-tags integration`): 10235 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped; full-discovery JSON reporter confirms both gh-1532 tests execute and pass in-suite.

### Notes

- The absolute 100ms-budget tests were not flaking (median-of-5 over ~10–20ms workloads tolerates outliers) and are unchanged.
- Test names unchanged — "2x input <= 3.2x time" still describes the gate, now applied to the best-of-3-attempts ratio.
- The lower bound (1.5x) sits well below the measured linear ratio (~1.9–2.0x locally across all three shapes) and uses the max across attempts, so jitter cannot push it under the bound without also being visible as a measurement failure elsewhere.
- An earlier broad `dart test` run (including integration-tagged suites) hit 13 failures + a native `malloc_consolidate` abort on this loaded runner under a non-CI tag selection; the CI-equivalent unit invocation above is fully green, and targeted runs of the affected integration files are unrelated to this test-only change.
